# Isaiah Chapter 18 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 7 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Land of whirring wings; swift messengers; God watching; future tribute from Cush*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Oracle Concerning Cush:** Land of whirring wings; swift messengers; God watching; future tribute from Cush. The key message for modern readers: "At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth"

*-- PNEUMA*
